Products

Fresh, natural products Michelle uses and recommends.

The same care that goes into a treatment should go home with you. Michelle carries the FRESH line from RINGANA, made in Austria from natural ingredients and produced fresh in small batches, with no synthetic preservatives.

Three staples cover the start of almost every routine she builds: a gentle cleanse, a micelle cleansing water, and a calming toner.

Wellness

Longevity, beyond the treatment room.

Healthy skin is one part of a longer story. For clients who are curious about the rest of it, Michelle is also a brand partner with Ellie MD, a telehealth platform focused on longevity.

Ellie MD programs are prescribed by licensed clinicians and filled through licensed pharmacies. Medical decisions rest with those clinicians, not with Michelle. Her role is simply to introduce clients who want to explore it, and to answer questions about her own experience as a partner.

Learn More at Ellie MD

About

One practitioner. One plan. Yours.

Aesthetics by Michelle is a solo practitioner skincare studio. Every appointment is one-on-one with Michelle herself: no revolving door of staff, no rushed treatments, no generic service menu.

With many years of experience in the beauty industry, Michelle builds each treatment plan around where your skin is right now, and gives honest recommendations, even when the honest answer is that you need less, not more.

  • One-on-one attention. Every appointment is with Michelle directly, start to finish.
  • Licensed and experienced. Idaho Esthetician License EST-292960.
  • Serving the region. Clients visit from Coeur d'Alene, Hayden, Post Falls, and Spokane Valley.
